name: content:read
description: Read-only vault content access: note reads, wikilink resolution, search, enumeration.

name: content:write
description: Vault content mutation: note writes, renames, moves.

name: agentic:write
description: Mutation of the agentic frontmatter layer (the agent.* / nav.* metadata) on vault notes.

name: git:sync
description: Converging the vault repository toward the remote without introducing agent-authored content into history: fetch, fast-forward, clean merge commits, submodule checkout and the pointer commit that records one, and reattach.

name: git:commit
description: Introducing agent-authored content into the vault repository's history: committing agent-authored working-tree changes, resolving conflicts, and pushing.

name: grants:manage
description: Grant administration: minting new scoped, time-limited bearer tokens.
